For |X_i| uniform, tau_i=ceil(log(1+|X_i|)/delta) almost surely, delta=-log lambda, giving exact CDF [min(1,e^(n delta)-1)]^d for n>=1. For d delta→gamma>0 and fractional phase r, ceiling convergence yields CDF exp[-2gamma(r-k)_+] and the frozen r>0 endpoint when d delta→infinity. Explicit tie convention is necessary for all-point dynamics, but law is almost sure.
